title: PPO with Beta Distribution on CarRacing-v0
meta: CarRacing · Reinforcement learning · Best leaderboard result
description: Demonstration of the PPO-Beta policy achieving 913 ± 26 over 100 episodes on CarRacing-v0 — the best result listed on the archived OpenAI Gym CarRacing-v0 leaderboard.

title: hGAIL in a dynamic urban environment
description: Hierarchical Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning controlling an autonomous vehicle in CARLA with traffic lights, pedestrians, and surrounding traffic.

title: hGAIL commanded turns at an intersection
description: Demonstration of command-conditioned behavior generation in CARLA, showing different plausible maneuvers at the same urban intersection.

title: Weighted Behavior Cloning for urban driving
description: Video demo associated with the Weighted Behavior Cloning project, illustrating autonomous driving performance in CARLA and complementing the comparison with standard behavior cloning.
